description: This file defines the Data Class 'ContentInfoViewModel' which encapsulates content information extracted from an Android Intent for the ContentInfoActivity. It includes constants for extracting extras and a method to construct an instance from an Intent.

classes.name: ContentInfoViewModel
classes.description: A lightweight holder class for content info, holding properties like title, subtitle, description, poster resource ID, channel number, and channel name.

methods.name: fromIntent
methods.description: Creates an instance of ContentInfoViewModel from an Intent containing content info extras.
